question: What attainment follows from reciting throughout the entire duration of an eclipse?
premises: Recitation is performed during the eclipse.
The duration spans from initial seizing to final release.
Lordship of success is named as the result.
inference: Reciting from the beginning to the end of the eclipse makes one lord of success.
plain_english: Having recited from the beginning of the eclipse to its release, one becomes the lord of success.
